text:
violet: I pushed a compact PR for tool-calling/parsing guidance and a tiny SDK shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/801. Need reviews on the examples and the fallback snippets.

omar: quick Q — are we standardizing on `tool_call` or `call_tool`? we have both in older docs.

violet: use `tool_call` going forward. add a short note in migration that maps older `call_tool` -> `tool_call`.

zane: saw a bunch of top-level arrays in examples. can we recommend a canonical top-level object shape so codegen and SDKs stay deterministic?

violet: yes. canonical example: `{ \"tool_call\": {\"name\": \"weather.get\",\"arguments\": {...}}, \"meta\": {\"source\": \"assistant\"}}`. include TS/Python types in the PR.

omar: added a tiny TypeScript helper to normalize incoming outputs and coerce args strings into objects when possible. snippet: `if (typeof resp.tool_call.arguments === 'string') try { resp.tool_call.arguments = JSON.parse(resp.tool_call.arguments) } catch {}`

zane: CI flagged link /docs/old/tool-calling.md 404

doc-bot: link-checker: /docs/old/tool-calling.md -> 404 (line 42)

omar: pushed a commit replacing with /docs/reference/tool-calling.md and updated internal anchors.

violet: add guardrail bullets at the top of the doc: 1) top-level object preferred, 2) one tool_call per response when invoking, 3) avoid top-level anyOfs.

zane: also add a small "troubleshooting" section: streaming truncation, escaped JSON strings, and serialized args. include a pragmatic fallback extractor (regex for first { ... }).

ovar-bot: docs build queued when merged.

violet: merge plan: if CI green and no objections by Wednesday 11:00 PT, merge and trigger docs deploy. I'll notify integrations channels after deploy. :rocket:
